version.description: the semver this release carries, without the v prefix

bump.description: major | minor | patch, derived from the range's commit subjects

commits.description: {sha, subject}, oldest first, for the range since the previous tag

laws.description: {before, after, files} read from scripts/laws.sh at each end; null where a count could not be read

surface.description: per surface (mcp_tools, mcp_tool_args, cli_flags, env_vars, domain_types) a sorted {added, removed}, or null when that surface could not be read at this tag

surface_unread.description: the surfaces whose file was present but yielded nothing readable
